description.paragraph1: TailwindLiquid is the must-have solution for Shopify merchants looking to transform their store into a highly converting shop. Thanks to optimized and customizable TailwindCSS and Liquid codes, you can boost your conversions, provide a smooth user experience, and give your store a look worthy of the best themes without spending hundreds of euros.
description.paragraph2: Designed by a fullstack developer, SEO consultant, and web designer with over 7 years of Shopify store creation experience, TailwindLiquid follows web standards and guarantees optimal SEO performance.
description.paragraph3: Join our dedicated Discord server, included with all packs, even one-time purchases, to ask your technical questions, share feedback, discover new features first, and co-build the next TailwindLiquid snippets with the community.
description.paragraph4: Shopify design and store audits will also be regularly proposed to identify improvement points. These audits will be exclusively reserved for subscribers.
description.paragraph5: TailwindLiquid's goal is to bring together an ambitious community of merchants and succeed together.

items: 1. Choose your pack: Select a credit pack based on your needs: Beginner Pack (20 credits), Advanced Pack (60 credits), or Pro Pack (90 credits).

2. Payment and login: Once your payment is validated by Stripe, your credits will be automatically added. You will then be invited to log in using the email address used at checkout. You will have to confirm your email to access your account.

3. Explore available codes: Once logged in, follow the instructions on the "installation" page to configure your Shopify theme, then explore the codes sorted by complexity level (1, 3, or 5 credits). Each code is designed to enhance a specific feature of your Shopify store.
4. Unlock a code: Depending on the number of credits you have, you can unlock basic codes (1 credit), intermediate (3 credits), or advanced (5 credits).
5. Add a code to your Shopify store:
Log in to your Shopify dashboard.
Go to "Customize theme."
Click on "Add section," then select "Custom Liquid."
6. Paste the code: Copy the unlocked code and paste it directly into the "Custom Liquid" section of your Shopify theme.
7. Save and admire: Click "Save," then instantly see the changes applied to your store.
Easy to use: No technical skills needed ;), just copy, paste, and you're ready!
Affordable: A cost-effective alternative to expensive Shopify themes (up to €350).
SEO optimized: Lightweight and efficient code to improve your store's visibility.
Compatible with all Shopify themes: Works perfectly regardless of your current design.
I am available to support you at every step, whether it is a technical issue or a question about installing or using the codes.
Contact me directly: Via Discord or by email: tailwindliquid@gmail.com
Can I get a refund? Yes, a refund is possible only if no credit has been used. Once a snippet is unlocked, the purchase is considered consumed.
How to request a refund? Just contact me by email with the address used for the purchase: tailwindliquid@gmail.com
Support at your service: Before any refund, I am here to help you resolve your technical issue. My goal is your satisfaction.
100% Secure Payment: All transactions are protected via Stripe and its official partners including Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut, PayPal, Amazon Pay, Link, and Twint.
Accepted Payment Methods: Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut, Link, PayPal, Twint, Bancontact, Amazon Pay.
Certification and Compliance: Stripe is PCI DSS Level 1 certified, the highest security standard for online payments.

ambassador.description: Join our exclusive ambassador program and take part in the Shopify development revolution!
offers: Cash commission: Earn a commission in euros for every sale generated through your referral. The more you share, the more you earn!
Early access: Get early previews of our new snippets and templates to stay ahead of the innovation curve.
Dedicated marketing tools: Access personalized materials, guides, and content to promote TailwindLiquid on your networks.

reviews.name: Ye Yun
reviews.content: I had a technical question about integrating a snippet and received a clear, prompt answer in less than an hour. Honestly, it's rare to find such support. Hats off for the professionalism!

reviews.name: Mickael L.
reviews.content: No bugs, everything works perfectly. I was a bit skeptical at first, but all the codes work flawlessly on my theme. No bugs, no slowdown... just new features for my store. Very reassuring.

reviews.name: Marwen L.
reviews.content: I was looking for a way to improve my Shopify store's appearance without breaking the bank, and TailwindLiquid was the perfect solution. Their snippets are super easy to implement and customize, letting me tailor the design exactly as I want.

reviews.name: Karim H.
reviews.content: Excellent value for money. For the price, it's unbeatable. Instead of paying a developer hundreds of euros, I installed premium features on my Shopify site myself. Very satisfied with the result.

reviews.name: Guillaume L.
reviews.content: Unique features found nowhere else. Some snippets add options I couldn't find in any Shopify app. It's super practical and lightweight—no need to install a whole app for a single function.

reviews.name: Abdelhaq M.
reviews.content: Incredible! It's perfectly designed for quick and easy testing. The credits system lets you choose exactly the snippets you need, without commitments or unnecessary expenses. No bloatware, you only pay for what you use. Highly recommended.

faq.title: Your Questions
faq.subtitle: Find here the answers to the most frequently asked questions to assist you in using your pack

items.title: What is a Liquid code?
items.content: Liquid is the programming language used by Shopify to customize and structure online store themes.

items.title: What is the Shopify Conversion Pack for?
items.content: The Conversion Pack improves design, enhances user experience, and significantly increases conversion rates.

items.title: Do these codes work with all themes?
items.content: Yes, the codes have been tested on a wide range of free and premium themes to ensure perfect integration.

items.title: What kind of features can I add?
items.content: With the Conversion Pack, you can add dynamic customer reviews, social proof, attractive CTAs, trust badges, and much more to improve user experience.

items.title: Do I need technical skills?
items.content: Not at all! Even a beginner can easily install them. Just copy-paste and replace the text or colors. And if needed, I am here to support you via Discord or email at tailwindliquid@gmail.com.

items.title: How does code installation work?
items.content: Installation only takes a few seconds. Just follow the instructions on the “Installation” page to ensure everything works perfectly.

items.title: Can TailwindLiquid slow down my store?
items.content: No. The code is optimized and lightweight. It integrates cleanly with your theme without impacting your store’s performance.

items.title: Can I get a refund if I am not satisfied?
items.content: Refunds are possible only if no credit has been used. Once a snippet is unlocked, the purchase is considered consumed.

items.title: What if I have problems?
items.content: I am available to help you at every step. Contact me directly on Discord or by email at tailwindliquid@gmail.com.
